login.heroDescription: Sign in to manage your organizations, access secured resources, and collaborate seamlessly across teams.
login.title: Access your account
login.subtitle: Enter your enterprise credentials to continue.

register.heroDescription: Register your organization email to access dashboards, manage workflows, and collaborate securely across portals.
register.title: Start your account
register.subtitle: Create credentials to access the client portal.

forgotPassword.heroTitle: Let’s get you back to your care.
forgotPassword.heroDescription: Request a private reset link, then return to your portal account when you are ready.
forgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email used for your account. We will send instructions if it matches a profile.
forgotPassword.sentMessage: If the email exists, reset instructions are on the way.

resetPassword.heroDescription: Use the reset link from your email, then create a password you do not use elsewhere.
resetPassword.title: Secure your account.
resetPassword.subtitle: The token may already be filled from your email. If it is missing or expired, request a new link.
resetPassword.doneMessage: You can now login with the new password.

profile.title: Keep your profile details up to date.
profile.description: Your contact details help keep your account and notifications synchronized.
profile.checkingSessionDesc: Preparing the protected profile workspace before loading customer data.
profile.loginRequiredDesc: Profile details are tied to your account session.
profile.changePasswordDesc: Choose a new password you do not use on other services.
profile.accountDetailsDesc: Authentication credentials and assigned profile properties.
profile.guideline1: Keep your phone and display name current to ensure accurate communication.
profile.guideline2: Verify your email to facilitate seamless account recovery.
profile.guideline3: Use strong, unique passwords for every environment.

gate.title: Protected customer route
gate.description: This MVP route requires an authenticated FO customer session before showing profile or notification data.
